image_description: An underwater scene featuring three scuba divers. The diver on the left wears an orange and black wetsuit with a BCD and tank, extending an arm upwards. The diver on the right wears a blue and black wetsuit with full gear, facing forward. A third diver is partially visible in the lower-left foreground, wearing black gear. Bubbles are rising from the regulators, indicating active breathing. The background consists of rocky seabed and murky water.
